  "title": "Add config parameter to remove save screenshots online button",
  "body": "Firefox Screenshots is a nice feature, but there are serious privacy issues.\r\n\r\nI'd like to disable the **upload to cloud** button(s). So that users cannot upload the screenshots. Saving locally is ok.\r\n\r\nI only found prefs to disable the screenshot extension system wide, but not for the insecure upload button. Can you add an about:config setting to disable the upload to cloud features, please?",
